intro: Guinea has been led by Mamadi Doumbouya since the 2021 coup.

chapters.title: How it works
text: A new constitution was approved in 2025, and Doumbouya won the December 2025 presidential election. Critics say opposition leaders were excluded.

chapters.title: Region
text: Guinea's relations with ECOWAS have been strained since the coup.
